title: Newgen Ping Hud
description: TAB ping and onscreen ping display. fully togglable and customizable.
body:
🏓 PingHud — Ping, Always in Sight

Know your connection at a glance — no guessing, no tab-hunting.


![showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32243a921c83a51dd4fac00b5861222387b39c60.png)
📡 What it does:
• Shows your ping (ms) right above the armor bar
• Appends ping next to every player name in the tab list
• Updates every second automatically

🎨 Fully customizable:

![settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9df2d82836385f079fb5732b316070ec0e4a871.png)
• Toggle HUD ping and tab ping independently
• Drag sliders to reposition the HUD anywhere on screen
• Pick custom colors for each ping tier:


  🟢 Good  ≤ 80 ms
  🟡 OK    ≤ 150 ms
  🟠 Bad   ≤ 300 ms
  🔴 Terrible > 300 ms

⚙️ Settings via Mod Menu:
All options are accessible through the Mod Menu config screen — no config file editing needed.

📦 Requirements:
• Fabric Loader
• Fabric API
• Cloth Config
• Mod Menu
